notes.title: Holiday Client Update!
notes.notes:
We've listened to your feedback and made a few improvements to the Windows, Mac, and Linux desktop clients! Additionally there are several more things in progress that will be ready by late December. Details to come at www.Spellbook.com soon!

In today's client patch many art assets have been updated and replaced with desktop in mind, and significant improvements were made to performance that will help save battery on laptops.

Many item display and map refresh bugs were also fixed.

We'll be running a Double BlackDollar Sale and holiday PvP event all weekend! 

Also be sure to check out our new tutorial gameplay video later today!
